_comment: Master Minecraft/NPC-instantiation registry. Split off from the old combined registry.json on 2026-08-05: this file now holds only what's needed to put a character's body in the game world - display_name/taterzen_name (the entity's in-game name), skin, taterzen_uuid, spawn_position. Everything about who the character IS - backstory, knowledge, criterion, life - now lives at _lore/characters/<key>.json, one file per character, which is this entry's counterpart joined by the same lowercased key. display_name/taterzen_name are populated here by copying the lore file's own 'name' field the first time a Minecraft entry is created for a character (by /embody or /spawn) - the lore file is the canonical source, this is a mirror kept here because Taterzens commands and scripts/minecraft/update_uuids.py need it locally. A character can exist purely as a lore file with no entry here at all, if they've never been embodied in-game.
